description: Quotes that venues have sent to the connected person's verified email address (for catering, events, conferences or group stays): the venue, quote number, total, the deposit asked, how long it is valid, the dates, and its lines, with a link to open it on WaitApp. The quote is accepted and any deposit paid by the person on that page; this tool only reads them. Needs a connected WaitApp account with a verified email.
name: list_my_quotes
title: List my quotes
